title: Link Sub-Account Below Minimum Balance Threshold
precondition: MAM group requires min $1,000 balance; investor account has $450.
steps: 1. Attempt to link sub-account to MAM group.
expected: Linking rejected with validation error: 'Account balance ($450.00) is below group minimum requirement ($1,000.00)'; account remains unlinked.
coverage_note: Zero-capital trade rejection tested; a configured minimum-balance JOIN threshold was not established.
